author: t81dev
body:
I, @t81dev, confirm that I am the Project Lead and sole active maintainer of T81 Foundation. I approve D1–D5 as documented in this decision, referencing proposal commit 71bb2c0e937dbcad73c9421e5465651b6e0d3ec3, including the exact 60 required entries and 17 preservation-only exceptions.

This approval authorizes preparation and testing of Scope A. It does not authorize policy activation, merging, branch-protection changes, artifact cleanup, or modifications to scientific results. Final activation remains subject to the accepted governance clarification, independent trust enforcement, verification evidence, and separate approval.
